question: A company models its profit for the month as a function $P(x) = \begin{cases} ax^2 + b, & \text{if } x \leq 4 \\ 3x + c, & \text{if } x > 4 \end{cases}$, where $x$ is the number of units sold in thousands. For optimal planning, the company wants $P(x)$ to be both continuous and differentiable at $x = 4$. Given that $a + b + c = 12$, determine $a$, $b$, and $c$, justifying all continuity and differentiability steps.
